ADDITIONAL COMMENTS: This environmental statement relating to the conservation of endangered species, while most noble and sincere in its word, is really an attempt to disrupt the evolution of the environment which has taken place for millions of years. We suspect that had the dinosaurs been able to have protection, they would not have become extinct and the environment today would have been substantially different. We talk about an attempt to protect all things, but really, history reveals that a continual change has taken place, and we suspect that they will continue irregardless of legislation or attempts at legislation.
